message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features the red masthead "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Below this, text reads "Kisruh Pelantikan Komisioner OJK H.72" and "Bisnis Haram Satwa Liar H.62." 

A central illustration shows three people inside a red car, viewed through the windshield. A man on the left, wearing a white collared shirt, sits in the driver's seat. He has a sad expression, with downturned eyebrows and eyes, and a wrinkled forehead. His hands are positioned on the steering wheel. To his right, a woman in a red shirt sits in the passenger seat. She has short black hair, wears glasses, and is shown in profile, looking away with a grumpy expression and crossed arms. Between them, leaning forward from the backseat, is a man with white hair and a wide, grinning expression. He has his arms crossed over the back of the front seats. 

At the bottom, white text reads "DIAM-DIAM DEMI GANJAR," followed by smaller text: "PDI Perjuangan terbelah mengusung Ganjar Pranowo berlaga dalam pemilihan presiden 2024. Presiden Joko Widodo menyiapkan jalan lain? H.24." A barcode and QR code are in the upper-right corner.
